description.en: Adds to hero personal attack and defense in combat.
Increases attack of all troops in armies led by the hero.
Increases defense of all own troops in armies with the hero.
Boosts resource production in the hero home village.

tribes.name: Romans
tribes.theme: Elite troops, strong infantry and cavalry, expensive training

description.en: Travian Roman hero — +100 fighting strength per point (tribe bonus).

tribes.name: Teutons
tribes.theme: Aggressive infantry and heavy cavalry, strong raiders

tribes.name: Gauls
tribes.theme: Fast cavalry, solid defense, fastest scouts

tribes.name: Egyptians
tribes.theme: Strong defense, cheap militia, stone wall synergy

tribes.name: Huns
tribes.theme: Pure offense, fast cavalry, weak defense

description.en: Mounted hero — armies move faster with hero (tribe bonus).

tribes.name: Spartans
tribes.theme: Crop-efficient defense, infantry scout, elite late-game hammer

tribes.name: Natars
tribes.theme: NPC endgame tribe — guards artefacts and Wonder plans

description.en: NPC hero for Natar villages and WW defenses.

tribes.name: Nature
tribes.theme: Oasis animals — no upkeep, captured with hero cages

description.en: Not a playable hero — represents oasis guardian presence.

tribes.name: Carthaginians
tribes.theme: Mercenary armies, elephants, and naval wealth — soft core infantry, elite mounted punch (Punic Wars (3rd–2nd c. BCE), North Africa / western Mediterranean)

description.en: Carthaginian commander in the mold of Barcid generals — cavalry and elephant coordination.

tribes.name: Japanese
tribes.theme: Ashigaru masses, samurai quality, weak native cavalry tradition (Sengoku / late medieval Japan (15th–16th c. CE), Japanese archipelago)

description.en: Sengoku warlord — infantry discipline and retainer quality.

tribes.name: Byzantines
tribes.theme: Cataphracts, disciplined themes, and combined-arms doctrine (Eastern Roman Empire (6th–11th c. CE), Anatolia / Balkans / eastern Mediterranean)

description.en: Theme commander schooled in combined arms and siege.

tribes.name: Israelites
tribes.theme: Hill-country infantry, slingers, and chariot elites of the kingdoms of Israel and Judah (Iron Age Israel & Judah (c. 1000–586 BCE), Levant / Canaan)

description.en: Royal captain in the tradition of David’s gibborim — infantry grit and chariot coordination.

tribes.name: Persians
tribes.theme: Vast levy infantry, Immortals, and horse archers of the Great King (Achaemenid Empire (6th–4th c. BCE), Iranian plateau / Near East)

description.en: Player hero — defaults to the account's in-game name; editable later.

tribes.theme: Dread host stronger than Natars and oasis Nature — relentless bone waves, spectral scouts, and catastrophic cavalry (Fantasy / necromantic, Grave-realms / cursed marches)

description.en: Deathlord of the grave — stronger than Natarian warlords and primal oasis spirits.

tribes.name: Median
tribes.theme: Statistical baseline — per-slot median of Romans, Teutons, Gauls, Egyptians, Huns, Spartans. Use as the balance origin for tribe identity offsets.

description.en: Baseline hero — median combat profile of the six original playable tribes.
